summary: Tested Dossier Express IA bug fixes. All 9 backend tests passed (100%). Backend fixes verified: admin-bypass returns immediately (<0.2s), status polling works, health endpoint responds during LLM processing (<0.15s). Frontend form loads correctly with all fields. Admin mode toggle works in admin dashboard but state is React context-based (not persisted in localStorage), so it resets on full page navigation.
critical_code_review_comments: Admin mode state (isAdminMode) is stored in React useState, not persisted to localStorage. This is intentional design but means admin mode resets on page refresh or full navigation.
seed_data_creation: Created multiple test dossiers via admin-bypass endpoint during testing
